_comment: Holding and throwing items (Game.hold_* / throw_held, FarmGrid.throw_target). Numbers are ours; see WORKLOG 2026-10-31 Holding.
_throw_cells: How far a throw goes. It lands on the farthest free cell up to this far; a building, the fence or an obstacle stops it short.
_flight_seconds: How long the thrown item is in the air (the 3D arc and the landing sound wait this long).
_arc_height: Highest point of the throw over the farmer's head, in cells (3D view).
_ship_into: Fixed cells that take a thrown item with a price and ship it (bin_total, paid at 18:00 or on sleep).
_lost_in: Fixed cells where a thrown item is gone for good.
